units.description: The original core. When damaged, the HP bar at the top of the battle decreases. When HP reaches 0, the fortress explodes and the battle ends.
Fires an arrow forward. High fire rate but short range.
Fires a three-round burst forward. Medium fire rate; bullets travel in a straight line.
Swings a sword forward. Fast attack speed and high HP.
Holds a shield that blocks enemy projectiles.
Throws a bomb forward. Short range but fast attack speed.
Fires a laser lasting about 1.5 seconds. The laser pierces and destroys all enemy bullets (except biological ones) and deals devastating damage to enemies it hits.
Fires a crossbow bolt forward. Very fast and with long range.
Thrusts with a lance. Medium attack speed, with the longest reach among melee balls.
Fires a shell. Long range and durable bullets.
Swings a naginata. Very large attack range and high attack power, with high HP.
Fires a spherical bullet forward that bounces off the surrounding boundaries. Bounces up to 4 times.
Throws a cluster bomb that splits into many small bullets in the air.
Attacks with a shotgun. Wide pellet spread and fast attack speed.
Automatically rotates at 1 degree per frame to aim at the enemy fortress core. Its sniper bullets have no travel path and hit the target directly.
Fires floating mines in a straight line. Large blast radius but slow bullets.
Fires homing missiles that automatically track the enemy fortress.
Restores the HP of fortress walls and fortress cores in range ahead.
Restores the HP of damaged balls in range ahead.
Deploys a hexagonal barrier. The barrier nullifies all enemy bullets it touches. The Barrier Ball periodically retracts to rest, and retracts immediately when damaged.
Releases a bomber that flies forward and continuously drops bombs downward.
Releases a tank that advances and fires shells after landing. Its shells are durable.
Fires continuously with a machine gun; the gun overheats and cools down periodically.
Releases the "ground guard army" of weak, swift, solid and paralyzing creatures in a 3:2:1:1 ratio to attack the enemy.
Creates straight barriers between pairs of wands that nullify all enemy bullets they touch.
A fortress wall with medium HP. Balls can stand on it.
A fortress wall with high HP. Balls can stand on it.
A fortress wall that breaks on contact. Balls can stand on it.
A fortress wall with extremely high HP. Balls can stand on it.
An accelerator with medium HP. Balls can stand on it. Increases the fortress's forward speed.
An accelerator with very high HP. Balls can stand on it. Greatly increases the fortress's forward speed.
Claws forward. Short range, slow attack, low attack power and low HP.
Fires a straight-line missile that gradually accelerates, with a decent blast radius.
Releases bouncy balls. They keep bouncing on landing, rising higher each time, up to 4 bounces.
Revives the last dead ball. Long cooldown.

Throws shuriken at enemies. A shuriken can exit the screen from behind your fortress and appear from behind the enemy's, passing through the ground until it leaves the horizontal edge of the screen a second time.
Draws a square with a pen. The square moves forward and then hardens, blocking enemy bullets.
Fires a slow firework that spreads outward when it explodes.
Uses a wand to reflect enemy bullets forward; reflected bullets take on the ball's own angle. Fast cooldown.
Emits a sound wave forward that knocks enemy entities backward on hit.
Fires a laser at nearby enemy bullets to destroy them. Fast cooldown.
Negates one instance of damage when an enemy fortress rams the core, then dies.
Makes all enemy balls that auto-aim at the fortress core target this ball instead.
Releases a missile cart that fires straight-line missiles diagonally upward. The missiles' blast radius is negligible (though it looks otherwise).
Releases boxes forward to block enemy bullets. Boxes fall under gravity and stop being released once they stack to the same height as the ball.
Throws a Claw Ball forward. It counts as an assaulted ball, and its attack angle matches the Dark Ball that threw it.
Releases a helicopter that spirals forward while firing three-round bursts diagonally downward.
Waves a fan to move assaulted allies in the direction the Fan Ball is facing.
Slashes with a knight's sword. Fast attack, high damage and very high HP, with a shield that blocks projectiles.
Fires a nuclear missile. Slow and durable; it detonates on contact with the enemy fortress base, enemy entities or enemy barriers, dealing massive area damage.
Fires an anti-materiel rifle. Very high attack power; its bullets have no travel path and hit the target directly.
Fires red rays for several seconds to lock onto enemies (same hit detection as the Magic Ball), then calls down a laser strike on the locked position (same detection as the Magic Ball).
Fires a cluster bomb that explodes after a time and splits into 8 small missiles. The small missiles home in on enemy balls; their blast radius is negligible (though it looks otherwise).
Fires piercing rounds that pass through enemies and shields. They can be shot down by enemy bullets.
Releases a red orb that automatically tracks and removes enemy bullets.
When the fortress rams, balls standing on top of this wall are assaulted forward.
Periodically (usually only the first time matters), balls standing on top of this wall are assaulted forward.
Balls standing on top rotate their angle up and down within a small range of -18 to +13 degrees.
Balls standing on top rotate their angle up and down within a larger range of -38 to +41 degrees.
Balls standing on top automatically aim at the enemy fortress core.
The wall moves up and down, reversing direction when it hits a boundary or another wall.

The core of Final Stage. At battle start it fires a red laser that slowly rotates with the direction of travel, adding one more red laser per 90 degrees of rotation, up to 4. After clearing Final Stage+, press "B" on the formation screen to use it.

The core of Final Stage+. At battle start it fires a green laser that quickly rotates with the direction of travel, adding one more green laser per 90 degrees of rotation, up to 4; it also releases 20 homing red missiles periodically.
